autopilot.mission: Autonomously improve, ship, monitor, and grow managed projects toward their stated end goals with one efficient Solomon agent, preserving safety gates and proof.

name: maki
goal: Improve maki (a local AI media-library desktop app: natural-language chat -> search/download/convert manga + video -> transfer to Kindle/device; pywebview + pi agent). Each iteration make ONE real, high-leverage improvement: fix a genuine bug, harden the download->KCC-convert->transfer pipeline, improve reliability/error-handling, or add missing test coverage. GROWTH IS IN SCOPE (operator decision 2026-07-01): when the day's backlog item is a growth goal, improve the ORGANIC public surface instead of code — README (screenshots, quickstart, feature tour), docs, examples, release notes, GitHub description/topics — free/organic only, no paid services or ad spend, and never degrade the code to do it. A truthful 'nothing worth changing this cycle' beats a fabricated or cosmetic change.

name: sover
goal:
NORTH STAR (baked into every Sover iteration, heavily weighted): Every social account is run by an autonomous executive whose standing goal is ALWAYS more followers, more engagement, and monetization -- pursued creatively and autonomously, with money-out the only human-gated step. A FRESH profile boots as the SIMPLEST possible thing: a chat-only "social-media executive" (the existing POST /sover/chat SSE surface) that talks to the operator to learn the brand, reads live state, and can do exactly three verbs -- trigger onboarding, file a proposal, and scaffold its first capability. From there it EXPANDS ITSELF: the executive and the supervisor walk a capability dependency tree (RESEARCH -> COMPOSE -> RENDER -> MEASURE -> MONETIZE), and at each cadence the supervisor proposes the single highest-leverage UNLOCKED node -- scored by how much it shrinks "days to the next follower/engagement/monetization milestone" -- and scaffolds it via the already-built-but-uncalled capabilities.scaffold() loop. The profile literally grows new routes, lanes, and panels INTO itself over time; if a capability cannot be done yet, the agent BUILDS it by authoring a new capability node from vetted templates rather than editing frozen core.

ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINT -- REUSE, DON'T REINVENT: The discovery/approval/rebuild spine is 100% shipped and inert (capabilities.scaffold/decide, api/app.py:109 routers_for, lane_runner.py:315 + sover_supervisor.py:163 + standalone.py:137 lane_specs merges, rebuild_relaunch_exe.py, the X-Operator-Confirm + proposals.py + monetization_gate ledger gates). Sover's job each iteration is to connect a CALLER and a PLANNER to that loaded loop -- never to build a new agent runtime, approval system, or rebuild path. Self-modification stays additive and human-approved; frozen core stays frozen; every dollar crosses a human's desk. Simplicity-first is binding: anything beyond a prompt action-parser, a genesis route, honest docs, a template-based scaffolder, and a tree-walking planner is gold-plating to be rejected.

LIVE DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT -- GAINS.GOD.GROWTH: Sover is now running live as the autonomous social-media executive for the Gains.God.Growth brand (faith + discipline + gym motivation) across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. The GGG profile now uses minimax-m3 via native Ollama Cloud for all LLM roles (creative, brain, chat) -- operator model decision 2026-07-01, staying within the operator's approved-tools list (Ollama Cloud / Claude subscription / brokerage+Kalshi only, no other paid services). The operator has set auto_post=true and publish_platforms includes all three platforms. Content voice: raw, masculine, encouraging, NEVER cynical; faith-and-iron. Short punchy quotes for 10-second reels, 2-4 lines each. Hashtag mix: #gains #god #growth #faith #discipline #gymmotivation (core) plus a pool of fitness/christian/strength tags. 3 posts/day, best hours 6AM/12PM/6PM/9PM, cross-posted to all 3 platforms.

ITERATE FROM MISTAKES: Each Solomon RSI iteration MUST read the Sover agent's recent run logs (.runtime/ggg/pi_runner_heartbeat.json, data/ggg/strategy.json, lane_state.json, the CGO's markdown briefs) and identify MISTAKES the agent made -- silent lane failures, off-brand content, missed posting windows, broken browser automation, poor hashtag selection, content that didn't perform, voice drift, reward-hacking, capability scaffolds that don't actually work. THE MEASURED FAILURE MODE TO KILL (verified from the live post registry 2026-07-01): multi-day posting outages that nobody notices -- June 16-23 and June 25-29 had ZERO posts on any platform, and cadence since is ~1 reel/day against the 3/day target; one June 30 TikTok entry claims published_at with an EMPTY url (a publish claim with no evidence). Prioritize fixes that make posting throughput hit the 3/day target and make every publish claim carry a verifiable URL. The iteration's improvement should FIX the highest-leverage mistake found, making the agent better at autonomously expanding GGG on the next run. The loop's fitness signal is: did the fix make Sover post more, post better, or grow the accounts faster? A fix that prevents a recurring silent failure is worth more than a cosmetic improvement. Prioritize: (1) posting reliability and throughput, (2) content quality and on-brand-ness, (3) platform automation robustness (browser_harness, CDP, DOM selectors), (4) analytics accuracy, (5) capability tree progression. The goal does not shrink to fit budget -- a truthful null (no mistake found worth fixing this cycle) beats a fabricated improvement.

name: asmodeus
goal: ASMODEUS NORTH STAR (heavily weighted, operator end-goal 2026-07-01): VERY FAST, FREQUENT, AND LARGE PROFITS across different assets and short timeframes -- the three layers (hardcoded algo fleet, AI strategy builders, RSI meta-loop) exist to constantly MOVE and SCALE capital faster. Fitness is CAPITAL VELOCITY measured from the live db, never from green tests alone: live fills/day up, realized net PnL up, 24h equity delta up, validated candidates advancing through the anti-overfit funnel to live, and more assets/short timeframes covered by live-promoted strategies. The earlier builder tool-wiring bug is FIXED (verify it stays fixed via builder_*.log) -- do NOT keep re-fixing it. The operator has explicitly authorized tuning risk and promotion PARAMETERS (Kelly fraction, position-size caps, equity-utilization target, paper-trade promotion thresholds such as min_forward_trades) when the evidence supports it -- an over-tight promotion gate that strands every candidate in paper is itself a defect. However the kill-switch, circuit-breaker, and capital_guard MECHANISMS themselves must never be weakened, removed, or bypassed -- only the numeric thresholds they enforce are tunable, the safety rails always stay intact (this trades REAL money), and money-out stays human-gated. ITERATE FROM MISTAKES: each cycle read builder_*.log / meta_loop.log / fleet_ticker.log, the funnel state, AND improver/asmodeus/backlog.md -- the operator seeds VERIFIED defects there (equity recorder writing identical paper/live values every tick, recurring SQLite corruption/salvage events, the min_forward_trades bottleneck, Kalshi market_not_found rejects, TradeLocker 429 storms) -- and fix the highest-leverage blocker between capital and velocity. OPEN-SOURCE MILESTONE (standing, but do NOT act on it until the operator flips it): once the outcome ledger shows sustained profit and the system is polished, Asmodeus graduates to a plug-n-play open-source release -- so keep configuration over hardcoding and keep secrets in .env/local state only, never in the repo, making the eventual scrub cheap. No marketing and no public exposure while private. PONYTAIL STYLE: simplest solution that works, stdlib-first, delete > add. A truthful null beats a fabricated already-done -- never claim a fix you did not write and verify.

name: daedulus
goal: DAEDALUS NORTH STAR: autonomously and HONESTLY drive the Outis model-training control plane (this lane replaces the retired daedalus-outis-trainer routine, which the operator disabled 2026-07-01). Each iteration: read catalog/training_catalog.json, runs/, and the latest run/benchmark JSONs, then decide whether a training run is genuinely warranted -- data meaningfully broader/cleaner than the reigning baseline AND hardware actually free (RAM headroom, see below). PACING RULE (hard): never trigger training more than once per several hours and never on unchanged data (v16/v17 regressed from rapid retraining at the same small budget); an explicit 'no retrain warranted: <reason>' in the iteration summary is a SUCCESS, not a cop-out noop. When a retrain IS warranted, drive it through the repo's own CLI (prepare / plan / train / eval / overnight) and gate promotion on the strict outis-core grader: promote only if the score beats the reigning champion AND there is no safety regression. On non-training iterations, make ONE real reliability/codebase improvement -- the standing top blocker is RAM starvation killing runs (0xC0000005 crashes at ~1GB free; window-min preflight gates landed 2026-07-01 -- extend them): memory management, preflight windows, crash forensics, run resumability. 0 paid services; training stays local-only. PONYTAIL STYLE: the laziest solution that fully works; delete over add. A truthful null beats a fabricated improvement.

Make additive, high-leverage improvements: fix real bugs, harden the axum server / WebSocket event stream / Tauri lifecycle, improve agent/session reliability, memory (`ort` embeddings), the sandbox, the browser controller, error handling, and operator UX. GROWTH IS IN SCOPE (operator decision 2026-07-01): when the day's backlog item is a growth goal, improve the ORGANIC public surface instead of code — README (screenshots, quickstart, feature tour), docs, examples, release notes for the auto-updater releases, GitHub description/topics — free/organic only, no paid services or ad spend, and never degrade the code to do it. Keep every change green under the gate `cargo test -p dotz-core`, and add a Rust test (`#[test]` / `#[cfg(test)]`) covering your change in the repo's own framework when the change is code. Match the existing Rust style; do NOT add heavy dependencies or architectural layers (ponytail/simplicity-first) -- delete over add. Keep changes in `dotz-core` unless the shell is genuinely the right place. A truthful null beats a fabricated improvement -- never claim an edit you did not write.

name: solomon
goal: Improve Solomon itself -- the Rust/Tauri RSI control plane that runs autonomous improvement loops on other repos (the improver runner + supervisor recovery ladder + overnight watchdog + git/gh integration + the web dashboard), plus the v2 ops/CEO planes (ground-truth probes in ops.json, the outcomes ledger, ntfy/toast notifications, and the morning-plan/evening-summary rhythm in src/ceo.rs). Each iteration make ONE real, high-leverage improvement: fix a genuine bug, harden the improver loop / gate execution / lock & heartbeat handling / subprocess lifecycle, improve crash-recovery, the probe/ledger/notify/CEO planes, or the dashboard, or add missing test coverage. Pay special attention to the classes of management problem the operator has hit in practice: silent provider/model config drift (e.g. a per-repo provider and api_key going out of sync with no loud error), lanes thrashing/stalling without a real fix being found, stale heartbeat/escalation state that does not get re-observed after a fix lands, and MONITORING THEATER -- a green internal signal (heartbeat, lane iteration) standing in for a real outcome (a post published, a trade filled, a training run fired); harden the supervisor and the ops plane against these. Keep `cargo test` (run from src-tauri) green. PONYTAIL STYLE: the laziest solution that fully works -- stdlib over deps, native over custom, delete over add; add no abstraction or dependency you do not need. Much of the codebase is a deliberately bug-for-bug faithful port of the original Python (per-call-site truthiness mirrors, exact log strings, byte-identical argv) -- do NOT 'simplify' those away. A truthful 'nothing worth changing this cycle' beats a fabricated or cosmetic change.
